purpose: Curriculum and dependency graph that connects the deterministic G17 skill taxonomy to proposed G18 cross-cutting learning families for AuraTrix and AulaFIX without creating duplicate domain skills.

snapshot.source_scope: G17 references and counts are read from the tracked repository snapshot. This G18 artifact adds only curriculum and graph metadata.
snapshot.content_boundary: Repository evidence establishes structure, paths and deterministic counts; it does not establish factual, technical, legal, educational, licensing or professional correctness. G18 family nodes are proposals, not promoted knowledge.

assumptions: The eight G18 family nodes are a curriculum design proposal; no repository count claims that they are implemented.
The six learning stages are a proposed AuraTrix/AulaFIX route; they are not counts of existing courses or completed learner outcomes.
A dependency edge expresses a curriculum relationship to validate, not proof that the upstream content is correct or sufficient.
G17 branch and skill IDs are reused as references only; this file does not change G17 ownership, pack assignments or corpus content.

non_redundancy_contract.g17_domain_owner_rule: Every existing G17 skill retains its one canonical owner and primary branch.
non_redundancy_contract.g18_scope_rule: A G18 family is a cross-cutting learning, evidence or governance capability. It must not restate the subject matter of an existing G17 domain skill.
non_redundancy_contract.facet_rule: Geography, period, lifecycle, artifact, risk and product route filter a node; they never create a second copy of a skill.
non_redundancy_contract.alias_rule: An alias or learner-facing label resolves to one G17 skill_id or one G18 family_id and is not an additional node.
non_redundancy_contract.source_rule: Source, interpretation, example and hypothesis remain separate in downstream records.
non_redundancy_contract.promotion_rule: No G17 or G18 node can become verified_knowledge from graph membership, counts or static presence alone.

g18_family_nodes.label: Provenienza, fonti e separazione epistemica
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Governs how a claim is sourced and labelled; it does not teach the AEC, legal, business or media subject itself.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: No source record becomes authoritative until provenance, version or date, jurisdiction or period, rights and a suitable human review are recorded.

g18_family_nodes.label: Contesto geografico, temporale e di ciclo di vita
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Applies facets and effective-date reasoning to G17 content; it does not duplicate Italian law, history or AEC domain knowledge.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: Current-law, safety, tax, procurement, permit and professional-compliance claims require territory, effective date, source and qualified human review; a facet is not legal advice.

g18_family_nodes.label: Mappatura semantica, alias e non-ridondanza
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Resolves identity, ownership and review status across packs; it does not replace technical content or delete similar material.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: Similarity, alias or token overlap never authorizes merge, deletion, answer-key exposure or ownership transfer; a human reviews provenance, intent and content.

g18_family_nodes.label: Evidenza, document lifecycle e audit trail
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Controls the lifecycle and auditability of an artifact; it does not duplicate technical reporting, estimates or templates owned by G17.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: A document-shaped file is not an authorized filing, estimate, inspection report, contract or professional opinion without the required reviewer, signatures, version and scope.

g18_family_nodes.label: Verifica runtime, interoperabilità e prove riproducibili
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Tests whether a digital workflow works in its intended environment; it does not duplicate CAD, BIM, coding or asset subject matter.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: Static parsing, file presence or a passing unit test does not prove production safety, structural adequacy, interoperability or professional conformity; runtime scope and qualified review remain explicit.

g18_family_nodes.label: Valutazione, esami protetti e qualità didattica
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Defines learning evaluation and protected assessment handling; it does not create new domain questions or answer keys.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: Public exam questions remain separate from protected answers; structural QA does not prove answer correctness, educational validity or source licensing.

g18_family_nodes.label: Review professionale, approvazioni e release
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Defines who must review a claim and when a route must stop; it does not perform legal, engineering, financial or safety practice.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: Legal/current-law, structural/MEP/calculation, safety, tax/procurement, valuation/insurance and publication/rights claims stop for qualified human review. No automatic filing, sending, payment, publication, certification or execution is authorized.

g18_family_nodes.label: Orchestrazione del percorso AuraTrix/AulaFIX
g18_family_nodes.non_overlap: Routes a learner and a case through existing skills and gates; it does not add a new construction, legal, digital or media subject.
g18_family_nodes.professional_review_boundary: AuraTrix may explain, route and prepare bounded summaries; AulaFIX may support a case workflow. Neither route replaces a qualified professional, sign-off, filing, payment, publication or execution.

evaluation_gates.label: Inventario deterministico
pass_when: G17 branch count is 12 and skill count is 36 from the source JSON.
All referenced IDs resolve and no G17 skill is duplicated.
evaluation_gates.does_not_prove: semantic correctness, coverage, licensing, runtime behavior or professional suitability

evaluation_gates.label: Provenienza e contesto
pass_when: Source, interpretation, example and hypothesis are separate.
Jurisdiction or geography and period/effective date are present where material.
Rights and reviewer fields are present or the item remains blocked.
evaluation_gates.does_not_prove: that the underlying source or interpretation is correct

evaluation_gates.label: Facet and route coverage
pass_when: The learning unit has geography, period, lifecycle, artifact, risk and product route facets.
A current-law or professional claim has an explicit stop condition.
evaluation_gates.does_not_prove: legal advice, universal geographic coverage or currentness without source review

evaluation_gates.label: Non-ridondanza e mapping umano
pass_when: Each alias resolves to one canonical ID.
Similarity signals produce review records and never autonomous merge or deletion.
Public exams remain separated from protected evaluation material.

evaluation_gates.label: Evidenza e lifecycle
pass_when: Artifact state, version, decision, reviewer and audit trail are recorded.
A blocked state is retained when an approval or source is missing.
evaluation_gates.does_not_prove: authorization to file, certify, contract or execute

evaluation_gates.label: Runtime and interoperability
pass_when: The relevant tool or workflow is exercised in its target environment with reproducible inputs and outputs.
Failures are retained with environment and reproduction data.
evaluation_gates.does_not_prove: production safety, engineering adequacy or professional conformity

evaluation_gates.label: Evaluation and professional review
pass_when: A protected evaluation is reproducible without exposing answer keys.
Qualified reviewer role is assigned for legal, safety, financial, calculation, rights or professional claims.
The reviewer decision and limits are recorded.
evaluation_gates.does_not_prove: that an unreviewed answer is authoritative

evaluation_gates.label: Release readiness
pass_when: Structural, provenance, semantic, runtime and professional gates agree for the scoped release.
Open blockers are visible and no automatic external action is implied.

dependency_edges.reason: Concepts and units precede measurement and formulas.
A calculation needs defined quantities, units and assumptions.
Structural reasoning consumes explainable calculation foundations; professional review remains separate.
Representation establishes the object and scope before material selection.
Components precede assembly and finish decisions.
Assembly knowledge precedes execution sequencing.
Structural intent informs execution constraints but does not authorize a design.
Systems literacy precedes energy option comparison.
Energy and systems context informs automation and critical-facility checks.
The proposed historical route is chronological.
Comparative present-day history follows the prior periods.
Asset validation requires understanding the representation and exchange workflow.
Automation can produce checks and data transformations that require validation.
G18 provenance governance extends the existing evidence skill without replacing it.
Lifecycle control consumes the existing record/document foundation.
Scope and effective context must be attached to a sourced claim.
Identity and equivalence decisions need source and purpose metadata.
Protected evaluation must know the canonical pack/skill mapping.
A controlled evidence packet needs provenance before lifecycle transitions.
Document status and review scope depend on geography, period and lifecycle.
Runtime tests consume a defined asset and data boundary.
Runtime results need reproducible evidence and failure records.
Evaluation records use the same controlled evidence boundary.
Reviewer scope is invalid without territory, period and lifecycle context.
Release decisions require an auditable artifact state.
Evaluation status is one input to release readiness, not a professional sign-off itself.
Runtime evidence informs a release gate when the route is digital.
Product routing must know when to explain, stop or hand off.
Delivery context informs a bounded case route without adding business subject matter.
AuraTrix presentation can use visual communication while rights and publication remain gated.

staged_learning_path.label: Orientamento e contratto di evidenza
staged_learning_path.AuraTrix_route: Explain the map, ask for missing scope and label uncertainty.
staged_learning_path.AulaFIX_route: Create a bounded intake record; do not infer a professional conclusion.
staged_learning_path.professional_boundary: No technical, legal, financial or safety decision.

staged_learning_path.label: Fondamenti e rappresentazione
staged_learning_path.AuraTrix_route: Teach concepts and surface assumptions with a non-authoritative explanation.
staged_learning_path.AulaFIX_route: Store the scoped artifact and its units, inputs and open questions.
staged_learning_path.professional_boundary: A worked example is educational; it is not a design approval or calculation sign-off.

staged_learning_path.label: Sistemi e ciclo di vita
staged_learning_path.AuraTrix_route: Compare options and explicitly distinguish reference material from verified knowledge.
staged_learning_path.AulaFIX_route: Maintain case state, evidence lineage and unresolved technical questions.
staged_learning_path.professional_boundary: Diagnosis, structural/MEP choices and safety actions stop for qualified review.

staged_learning_path.label: Sistema italiano, documenti e delivery
staged_learning_path.AuraTrix_route: Explain the route, cite scope and stop before advice or filing.
staged_learning_path.AulaFIX_route: Track versions, required evidence, reviewer assignment and blockers.
staged_learning_path.professional_boundary: Current-law, permits, procurement, tax, safety, contracts and professional documents require qualified human review.

staged_learning_path.label: Digitale, mapping e valutazione
staged_learning_path.AuraTrix_route: Coach through alias resolution, uncertainty and protected assessment without exposing answer keys.
staged_learning_path.AulaFIX_route: Run bounded checks, retain logs and surface reproducible failures.
staged_learning_path.professional_boundary: A passing test does not establish production safety, rights clearance or professional conformity.

staged_learning_path.label: Caso supervisionato e release
staged_learning_path.AuraTrix_route: Summarize what is known, unknown, blocked and ready for a human decision.
staged_learning_path.AulaFIX_route: Package evidence, decisions, open issues and assigned reviewer; keep release blocked when a gate is open.
staged_learning_path.professional_boundary: No automated certification, filing, payment, publication, professional sign-off or execution.

coverage_invariants.graph_node_count_basis: 36 deterministic G17 skill nodes plus 8 proposed G18 family nodes; branch labels are grouping metadata, not additional skill nodes.

non_goals: This artifact does not modify docs/coordination/UNI_SKILL_TAXONOMY_G17.json or any corpus file.
This artifact does not assert that any G18 family, stage or output is implemented, complete or verified knowledge.
This artifact does not merge, delete, rewrite or license source, cards, exams or media assets.
This artifact does not expose protected exam answers or certify educational correctness.
This artifact does not authorize legal advice, engineering design, safety certification, valuation, filing, payment, publication or execution.
